_readme: Template of the PRIVATE configuration (kept outside the public repository). Domains, log locations, trap paths and the check User-Agent below are placeholders: the real ones identify the studied sites and are never published. Trap paths are random strings (a random folder per site and a random segment per arm), so nothing in them describes the arm. Times are UTC ISO 8601, filled in by the deploy verification when each phase is verified live; leave them null until then.
